description: Ralph Wiggum loop project: TOML-driven, deterministic offline mock data generator (Python) outputting to SQLite. Supports domain dictionaries as assets and scenario-driven fact generation (fraud injection at 0.5%, time-series MoM growth with June dip). LLM used only for authoring TOML/specs and optional one-time asset creation, never at runtime.
definitionOfDone: All stories in the current loop are implemented
All unit and integration tests pass
Verifier scripts pass and were not modified except by explicit verifier-change story
CLI commands for the loop are functional
A loop progress entry is added under progress/ with results and next risks
Spec examples for new features are added under specs/

loops.title: Project skeleton + spec validation + SQLite baseline generation
loops.goal: Create runnable CLI, validate TOML spec structure, generate 2 simple tables into SQLite deterministically.

stories.title: Repo scaffold and OpenCode/Ralph loop structure
acceptanceCriteria: Repo contains docs/, src/, verify/, specs/, assets/, progress/
OpenCode entrypoint documented (how to run loops)
Basic CI/test runner exists (pytest)
tests: pytest runs and passes trivial test
verify/ harness runs and reports baseline status

stories.title: TOML spec loader + strict validation models
acceptanceCriteria: spec.toml parsed and validated
Meaningful error messages for missing/invalid fields
format_spec canonicalizer produces stable ordering
tests: unit: invalid spec cases produce expected errors

stories.title: SQLite writer baseline (schema + inserts)
acceptanceCriteria: Engine creates SQLite db, creates tables, inserts rows
Transaction + batch inserts implemented
Deterministic seed yields identical outputs across runs
tests: integration: generate small db and verify row counts
integration: rerun with same seed yields identical table checksums

loops.title: Schema graph + PK/FK ordering + basic generators
loops.goal: Support PK/FK definitions in TOML, compile dependency DAG, generate parent tables before child tables.

stories.title: Schema compiler builds table dependency graph
acceptanceCriteria: FK graph built from TOML
Topological sort determines generation order
Cycle detection emits NEEDS_CAPABILITY:CYCLE_HANDLING
tests: unit: DAG sort order correct for sample spec

stories.title: Primary key generators (sequence, uuid)
acceptanceCriteria: sequence PK supported
uuid PK supported
PK uniqueness validated in verifier

stories.title: Foreign key generator (uniform selection from parent keys)
acceptanceCriteria: Child FK values always reference valid parent keys
Optional weighted FK selection reserved for future capability
tests: integration: FK integrity validated with PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON in verifier

loops.title: Assets registry + dictionary sampling + derived fields
loops.goal: Enable domain lists (medications, business names) from files; add derived field expressions.

stories.title: Assets registry for dictionaries (CSV/JSON)
acceptanceCriteria: assets.dictionary entries load from file
Optional weight column supported
Spec references resolve to assets

stories.title: Dictionary-based field generator
acceptanceCriteria: Fields can reference assets dictionaries
Optional unique constraint enforcement on a field (best-effort MVP)
tests: integration: values come from dictionary set

stories.title: Derived fields (simple expression language)
acceptanceCriteria: derived generator supports expressions referencing prior fields in row
Expressions are validated at spec-compile time

loops.title: Scenario primitive: injection + mutation (fraud 0.5%)
loops.goal: Support fraud injection at a target rate with deterministic row selection and correlated mutations.

stories.title: Scenario framework + overlays
acceptanceCriteria: Scenario selection via CLI
Scenario seeds override project seed
Scenario applies inject/mutate plan deterministically
tests: integration: scenario run produces stable outputs

stories.title: Injection engine (rate-based row labeling)
acceptanceCriteria: Inject marks ~0.5% rows with label field
Deterministic selection stable across runs and parallelism settings
Exact-count mode supported (round(rate*N))

stories.title: Mutations on injected rows (amount/channel/merchant)
acceptanceCriteria: Injected rows receive altered distributions
Mutations can set fields via generator blocks
Mutations can be conditional on where-clause
tests: integration: fraud amounts higher than baseline statistically

stories.title: Scenario assertions (expression and SQL)
acceptanceCriteria: Assertions run automatically after generation (if enabled)
Assertions produce JSON report with pass/fail and metrics
tests: integration: failing assertion returns non-zero exit code

loops.title: Time-series fact shaping (MoM growth + June dip)
loops.goal: Generate sales facts with upward monthly trend and a June outlier at -20%, optionally cohort-specific.

stories.title: Monthly schedule generator for fact tables
acceptanceCriteria: Facts can be generated by month within a date range
Trend model supports compound growth monthly_rate
Scenario can override month volume_multiplier

stories.title: June dip scenario override
acceptanceCriteria: June volume is ~20% below expected trend
Other months follow growth trend
Summary report shows monthly totals
tests: integration: month totals verify June outlier

loops.title: Validation reports + summarize + plan output
loops.goal: Make outputs consumable: plan JSON, validate report, summarize report, assertion report.

stories.title: plan command outputs compiled plan JSON
acceptanceCriteria: Plan includes table order, row counts, required assets, scenario operations
plan output is stable across runs

stories.title: summarize command outputs dataset metrics
acceptanceCriteria: Row counts per table
Null rates per column (sampled for huge tables in MVP)
Scenario-specific metrics (fraud rate, monthly totals)

loops.title: LLM authoring kit (offline) for generating new TOMLs
loops.goal: Provide prompt packs and canonical examples so an LLM can reliably generate new specs; generator still runs offline.

stories.title: Publish canonical spec schema + examples for LLM input
acceptanceCriteria: docs/specReference.md exists (DSL reference)

acceptanceCriteria: validate command runs spec+asset validation and exits non-zero on errors

ER diagram includes tables, columns, PKs, FKs

hello table created with 3 rows
